answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21167 Country: India Title: WHAT IS THE SUNNAT WAY OF SEX INTERCOURSE WITH WIFE? Question: ASSALAM O ALEKUM, WHAT IS THE SUNNAT WAY OF SEX INTERCOURSE WITH WIFE? Answer ID: 21167 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 518/518/M=1431) While having intercourse one should not be completely naked, it is forbidden in hadith. Sheet etc should be wrapped. In the same way the leg should not be turned towards qiblah. It is mustahab (desirable) to make wudhu or ghusl between two intercourses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
